guest.notes: requires apple hardware for a legitimate guest; bespoke machine definition with smc

constraints: apple's licence restricts virtualising macOS to apple hardware: on anything else this entry stays refused
no metal: gpu-accelerated apps will refuse to run, and software rendering is the only fallback
needs ovmf plus smc emulation and apple boot quirks, so the machine definition is bespoke, not a stock q35
icloud and licence activation may flag a virtual machine: assume local-only apps as the supported workload
last release before catalina dropped 32-bit apps: this is the 32-bit app lane
